canonical_rule.text:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g)))
    (grid-from-fn h w (lambda (r c)
      (let ((v (cell-at g r c)))
        (if (!= v 0) v
          (let ((colors (filter (lambda (v2) (!= v2 0))
                   (map (lambda (cc) (cell-at g r cc)) (range 0 w)))))
            (if (null? colors) 0
              (let ((color (find-first (lambda (col)
                      (let ((left (find-first (lambda (cc) (= col (cell-at g r cc))) (range 0 c)))
                            (right (find-first (lambda (cc) (= col (cell-at g r cc))) (range (+ c 1) w))))
                        (and left right)))
                    (unique colors))))
                (if color color 0)))))))))))

identifiability.scope: All three declared parameter rivals; no claim about arbitrary alternative rules.

rule.text:
(rule!
 ;; In each row, collect anchors independently for each nonzero color.
 ;; A color needs at least 3 anchors before it can fill any intervening zeros.
 ;; Preserve every original nonzero cell; never extend past the outer anchors.
 ;; If spans overlap outside the sampled grammar, the smallest color wins.
 (lambda (g)
  (grid-from-fn h w
   (lambda (r c)
    (let ((v (cell-at g r c)))
     (if (!= v 0) v
      (let* ((colors (unique
                      (filter (lambda (value) (!= value 0))
                        (map (lambda (k) (cell-at g r k)) (range 0 w)))))
             (color
              (find-first
               (lambda (candidate)
                (let ((positions
                       (filter (lambda (k) (= candidate (cell-at g r k)))
                         (range 0 w))))
                 (and (>= (length positions) 3)
                      (< (first positions) c)
                      (> (last positions) c))))
               colors)))
       (if color color 0))))))))

limits: Task-local prototype; no production parameter API or approval change.
Four settings and one retained episode per setting at the recorded seed.
Identifiability is measured only against the three other declared parameter settings.
Sampling uses disjoint repeated-color spans in the chosen axis, both dimensions 6..30.
Default APIs select the canonical setting; sample_parameters(seed) explicitly samples a fixed setting.
The selected canonical generator is recorded for context but is not used to construct prototype inputs.
